request: T-Rex recording. You start in the cave just before the zip-line. Without using the zip-line, find the way down to the valley below it where the T-Rexes are (one may only appear once you're down there). Wake a T-Rex and let it chase you for a while, running around it so it turns and walks/runs after you. Shoot it with the pistols until it dies (one is enough; both if it's easy). If you can, finish by letting the other T-Rex (or a fresh one) catch Lara so we see its kill animation. Please don't open the inventory or pause mid-fight if you can avoid it. Close the window when done, and leave a note with roughly what happened (which T-Rex died, whether Lara was eaten).
